title: Knapp and Corbell broke the Fravor Tic Tac story on radio before the New York Times
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Knapp and Corbell broke the Fravor Tic Tac story on radio before the New York Times, about before 2017 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: is George Knapp and I did break the Commander Fravor story, the Tic Tac story. We did it quietly on the radio twice before the 2017 New York Times article.
